description: Defines functions, macros, and inline methods for safe size_t computations, including overflow checks and size calculations, used to prevent memory allocation errors due to overflow in size calculations.

methods.name: xsum
methods.description: Calculates the sum of two size_t values with overflow check, returning SIZE_MAX on overflow.

methods.name: xsum3
methods.description: Calculates the sum of three size_t values with overflow check.

methods.name: xsum4
methods.description: Calculates the sum of four size_t values with overflow check.

methods.name: xmax
methods.description: Returns the maximum of two size_t values with overflow considerations.
